llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous scam signals: (1) Unusually strong language around free offers, guaranteed payouts, and excessive bonuses; (2) Spoofing a legitimate brand (Lazada)—pointing to attempted impersonation; (3) Offering a huge array of products that blend gambling/casino with shopping in an unrealistic way for a real business; (4) SSL certificate issues and lack of professional business contacts, relying instead on WhatsApp; (5) The domain is hidden in WHOIS and is flagged for abuse. All these signs align with typical Fake Online Shopping scams that attempt to leverage psychological triggers and brand spoofing to lure victims.
